title: ANdroid Auto
symptom: User requests Android Auto support in xDrip to hear/see blood glucose readings while driving, but xDrip readings do not appear on Android Auto display.
fix: The thread suggests using Android APS with a virtual pump to get xDrip data to Android Auto, or using the CarNotifier app to put notifications onto Android Auto.
evidence_quote: I found an app that will put the notification onto android auto, it is much better than AndroidAPS. It is CarNotifier.
